summary: decompose god module scan by extracting semcod quality artifact scanners

delivery.outcome: Decompose the `God Module: src.koru.scan` smell by extracting the semcod quality artifact scanning subsystem (jscpd, code2llm, testql, redup, vallm, pyqual, prefact, regix, redsl, metrun, pfix, todo2code) from src/koru/scan.py into src/koru/scan_artifacts.py. This reduces scan.py from 2,083 to 836 lines (a 60% reduction) while preserving 100% backward compatibility via explicit re-exports in scan.py.
nonGoals: Changing the parsing logic or thresholds of any artifact scanner
Modifying core scan suggestion deduplication or ticket emission
Breaking public or internal import paths from koru.scan

architecture.decision: All external semcod quality artifact scanners and their parsing helpers are cleanly extracted to koru.scan_artifacts. src/koru/scan.py re-exports all pre-existing public and internal symbols so all callers, CLI invocations, and tests remain completely unbroken.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit to restore inline artifact scanners in scan.py and remove scan_artifacts.py.

validation.evidence: All 9 dedicated unit and contract tests in tests/test_scan_artifacts.py pass.
All 24 regression tests in TestScanSemcodArtifacts pass without modification.
Ruff check and format report 0 findings.
The governance gate reports 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
